en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of an ornately carved stone gateway, apparently a main gate of a castle ruin. The arch has relief figures above it, including what appear to be knights, and the year '1527' is inscribed above the entrance. The surrounding area is rustic, with part of a stone pathway leading through the gate and overgrown plants on the side. On the bottom edge, handwritten German text identifies the location.
